== Summary ==
Before/after crops for [[Lothal: Imperial Complex (Errata)]]: Left: the image of [[Lothal: Imperial Complex]] (published 10 August 2022, [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/25528d7b73b5e6206de765d700504be693fc39da/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual19-Dark/large/lothalimperialcomplex.gif holotable 25528d7]); right: the image of [[Lothal: Imperial Complex (Errata)]] (published 30 December 2024, [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/9d2c01ed1603f793dc8a0569c99d4b544378da9b/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual19-Dark/large/lothalimperialcomplex.gif holotable 9d2c01e]). Same area (x 269–1039, y 28–108) cropped from each published image <code>lothalimperialcomplex.gif</code>; pixels unchanged. Made by placing the two unscaled crops side by side (Bill, 12 November 2026: every version article shows cropped screenshots of what changed).
